title: The Impact of Education on Chronic Disease Risk

llm_response.content:
## 1. Identification Strategy

The research question aims to establish a *causal* relationship between educational attainment and chronic disease risk. A simple OLS regression of chronic disease (y) on education (x) would likely suffer from endogeneity bias. This is because unobserved factors such as innate ability, family background, or time preferences could influence both an individual's educational attainment and their propensity to develop chronic diseases, leading to biased OLS estimates.

To address this endogeneity, we will employ an **Instrumental Variables (IV)** approach, specifically using **Two-Stage Least Squares (2SLS)**. The proposed instrument is **quarter-of-birth (z)**.
